S02.conclusion: not a standing code defect; the artifact assertion raced an artifact that had not been produced yet on that run, and three subsequent runs passed
S02.input_error_admitted: the observation given to Deep marked code_defect true for S02; that flag was the operator's inference from repeatable=true and was wrong. Deep routed correctly for the input it was given, so this is an input-quality fault, not a reasoning fault

planner_mechanism_finding.statement: the planner needs explicit item grouping; with a natural three-group layout it splits correctly, without one it returns a null plan regardless of field length or prompt brevity
planner_mechanism_finding.implication: self-directed open work must be expressed as grouped checklists, otherwise it is dead on arrival
